title: melanchrysum pavonium
intro: Melanchrysum pavonium, commonly known as Yellow Chamomile, is a flowering plant of the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Melanchrysum pavonium include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of insomnia, restlessness, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include apigenin, a flavonoid that has been shown to have a sedative effect and reduce anxiety, as well as chamazulene, an anti-inflammatory compound that can help soothe digestive issues.
